featuredProjects.name: EEEA-Py
featuredProjects.description: Led modular architecture, test suite, and the Python-vs-R benchmark study for a package implementing EES (Salinas-Gutiérrez & Muñoz Zavala, 2023) as a population-initialization strategy across EMNA, PSO, and GWO metaheuristics.

evidence.title: EXPERIMENTAL EVIDENCE
evidence.context: Cross-language benchmark comparing Python and R implementations of EES across 30 independent runs (Sphere function, dim=10).

featuredProjects.name: EvoBench
featuredProjects.description: Python framework for benchmarking evolutionary algorithms against classic n-dimensional test functions.

featuredProjects.name: MNIST Bench
featuredProjects.description: Paired comparison of an MLX-based MLP and a scikit-learn One-vs-One SVM on a stratified 15k-sample subset of MNIST, using 10-fold cross-validation and formal hypothesis testing.

featuredProjects.name: Sleep Staging GNN
featuredProjects.description: M.Sc. thesis proposal: a Graph Neural Network enriched with copula functions to classify sleep stages from EEG while remaining invariant to electrode montage. Advised by Dr. Rogelio Salinas Gutiérrez and Dra. Ivonne Bazán Trujillo, UAA.

featuredProjects.name: Image Interpolation Methods
featuredProjects.description: Comparative study evaluating Global Bilinear Lagrange, Local Bilinear Lagrange (2×2 planes), and a random baseline for image reconstruction on the Waterloo benchmark dataset (grayscale and color).

evidence.title: EXPERIMENTAL EVIDENCE
evidence.context: Average relative reconstruction error (Euclidean/Frobenius norm) across 12 grayscale benchmark images. The initial hypothesis — that the global model would outperform the local one — was rejected: the global polynomial proved numerically unstable at this resolution.
footer: Local model was the only numerically viable method

featuredProjects.name: Pixiter
featuredProjects.description: Desktop GUI for shape analysis using Freeman Chain Codes, including contour representation, geometric descriptors, information-theoretic analysis, compression, and shape reconstruction. Co-authored with Victoria Galván for the course Nuevos Paradigmas Tecnológicos.

evidence.title: SHAPE ANALYSIS CAPABILITIES
evidence.context: ShapeMetrics-Interface v1.0 implements an end-to-end workflow for encoding, analyzing, compressing, storing, loading, and reconstructing 2D shapes from Freeman Chain Codes.
items: 5 chain-code variants: F4, F8, AF8, VCC, and 3OT
Contour extraction and binary shape reconstruction
Geometric descriptors: area, perimeter, compactness, and Euler characteristic
Shannon entropy and Huffman/arithmetic coding analysis
Chain-code persistence with metadata and histogram export
footer: Desktop GUI · Image processing · Information theory

featuredProjects.name: Zebrafish ECG Acquisition & Analysis System
featuredProjects.description: Bachelor’s thesis project focused on acquiring, transmitting, visualizing, storing, and analyzing electrocardiographic signals from zebrafish models. The system combines embedded acquisition, LAN/Wi-Fi communication, a Python desktop interface, real-time ECG visualization, BPM estimation, and digital filtering.

evidence.title: SYSTEM CAPABILITIES
evidence.context: Developed as a Bachelor's thesis in Biomedical Engineering for in vivo ECG acquisition and analysis in zebrafish cardiotoxicity studies.
items: Real-time ECG signal acquisition and visualization
CSV signal storage for later analysis
footer: Embedded systems · Networking · GUI development · Biosignal processing
